mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level, as measured by the current FEDFUNDS value, reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship is consistent across all monetary regimes.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for UNRATE (with trigger UNRATE>5.0%) against 20-day forward returns is above -0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns in triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which depresses corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction of HOUST and RSAFS (both declining) against 60-day forward returns is above -0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns in interaction-triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock, when industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO (with trigger INDPRO<100) against 5-day forward returns is above -0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns in triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When residential housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it indicates a downturn in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST (with trigger HOUST<1000) against 20-day forward returns is above -0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns in triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and has increased by more than 0.1 percentage points over the past three months, the resulting higher borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS (with trigger FEDFUNDS>4.5% and 3-month change>0.1%) against 5-day forward returns is above -0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns in triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO (with trigger INDPRO<100) against 60-day forward returns is above -0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns in triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction of PAYEMS (declining) and UNRATE (rising) against 20-day forward returns is above -0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns in interaction-triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
